episodes.201073: A stacked low pressure system over central North Dakota resulted in thunderstorms moving through the area, a few of which produced small hail. One storm produced a funnel cloud near Heaton in Wells County.
episodes.201132: Line of showers moving over Lake Michigan produced strong winds at the surface.

events.narrative: Sheboygan Light (SGNW3) C-MAN station measured a 34-37 knot or 40-43 mph wind gust between  2310-2340z (04/13/2025).
